![list](221,288,701,312)
- Find all tuples in which the amount of loan is more than \$12000.

![formula](276,311,444,335) $\sigma_{amount > 12000} (Loan)$

![list](219,344,832,370)
- Find those tuples pertaining to loans of more than \$ 12000 made by "GMU" branch.

![formula](273,370,748,396) $\sigma_{amount > 12000 \land branch = 'GMU'} (Loan)$

![list](218,400,564,422)
- List all loan numbers and the amount of loan.

![formula](276,422,467,446) $\pi_{loan\#, amount} (Loan)$

![list](217,455,615,477)
- Find the names of all customers who live in "airfax".

![formula](290,477,597,503) $\pi_{name} (\sigma_{city = 'airfax'} (Customer))$

![list](216,512,836,535)
- Find the names of all bank customers who have either an account or a loan or both.

![formula](278,535,832,561) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) \cup \pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](216,569,817,588)
- Find the names of all customers of the bank who have an account but not a loan.

![formula](287,588,647,620) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) - \pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](215,625,745,644)
- Find the names of all customers who have both a loan and an account.

![formula](295,642,682,681) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) \cap \pi_{name} (Borrower)$
